Introduction: Oh, hello. Sorry, I was counting. Doesn't matter, I'll start again.#$b#Auden Fairweather. I teach astronomy here. Well, I teach it on clear nights. On cloudy ones I mostly apologise.$h
Mon: First-years think divination means knowing the future. Mostly it means knowing which tea leaves stain.
Tue: I charmed these glasses so I can see starlight in the daytime. Brilliant idea, terrible headache.$u
Wed: Wednesday. The observatory roof leaks on Wednesdays. I don't know why. I've stopped asking it.
Thu: If you see a comet tonight, it's probably a comet. If it waves, it's probably a second-year on a broom.
Fri: Fridays I take the lantern up to the tower early. It's a ritual. A very small, very cold ritual.
Sat: No lessons today. I'm going to read something with no diagrams in it at all. Revolutionary.$h
Sun: Sundays are for mending star charts. The ink fades if you don't speak to it kindly.
Mon4: I saved you a seat at the telescope on Thursday. Unless you'd rather not. You'd tell me, wouldn't you?
Wed4: The leak's back. I put a bucket under it and named it after you. That's a compliment, I promise.$h
Fri6: Come up to the tower after dark sometime, @. There's a cluster in the east I've never shown anyone.$l
Sun8: I keep finding new constellations, and they all look a bit like you. That's... not very scientific of me, is it?$u
Sat10: Whatever the stars say about next year, I'd like you in it. There. I said it.$l
spring_Mon: Spring skies are hazy. Good for wishing, bad for measuring. I do a lot of wishing in spring.
summer_Wed: Too warm in the tower. The telescope fogs and so do I.$s
fall_Fri: Autumn is the best season for stargazing. Long nights, clear air, excellent excuses to stay up.$h
winter_Sun: My birthday's in winter. The sky's at its clearest then, so I've never minded the cold.
AcceptGift_(O)395: Coffee. You've just saved three lectures and possibly a life.$h
AcceptBouquet: For me? I... yes. Yes, of course. I've been hoping, quietly, for longer than I'd like to admit.$l
RejectBouquet_NotDatingYet: Oh. That's very kind. I think we should know each other a little better first, don't you?$s
RejectBouquet_VeryLowHearts: I'm flattered, truly. But I hardly know you yet.$s
RejectBouquet_Divorced: I think we both know that would be a mistake.$s
